promptHead: Athlete goal: marathon (Wexley Lakes Marathon) on Sun Oct 18 2026, 2 weeks out, target under 3:45.

new.headline: This week cuts volume and adds a short race‑pace run to keep your body fresh for race day.

new.analysis:
The goal this week is a classic taper. With the race only two weeks away, the athlete should lower overall volume while keeping one brief quality session to preserve race‑pace feel. The previous week ran 41.99 mi, with a 17 mi long at 9:59 mi. We cut the long to about 12 mi, which keeps the legs used but reduces fatigue. A 3‑mile at marathon pace (≈9:10 mi) replaces the previous 9‑mi threshold run, ensuring the body sees the effort level needed without the accumulated stress of a long hard session. Easy runs stay in HR zone 2, staying under 150 bpm, and rest days remain solid. Volume drops about 25 %, a typical 2‑week taper figure. Heart‑rate drift is expected to be lower this week because the warm‑ups and cool‑downs are lighter. The short race‑pace session is spaced two days after the long to allow adequate recovery. This schedule should keep recovery high and readiness for the Oct 18 race.

Key: keep the race‑pace run 2‑3 mi, run the long at easy pace with a 2‑mi finish at target, watch recovery, and maintain rest days. No red flags appear.
